calculation.description: At the completed session close, rank assets by the negative same-session open-to-close return; this is a contrarian intraday reversal signal for the next session. Only completed OHLC data are used.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.054314), 2023-2024 (+0.055291), and 2025-2026 (+0.041595), supporting cross-regime consistency. Small cross-asset sample implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
